text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Bram out (Greta covering); Dell out (Rafe covering); Jonah/Bram swapping desks. Pia/Leon swapping desks. Greta covers Mira (out all week). Cora/Mira swapping desks. Suri/Nils swapping desks. Una/Vik swapping desks. Leon/Teo swapping desks. Teo covers Una (out rest of week). Rafe involved. Vik and Wren involved.
Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, and garden studio are slow. East wing too cold in afternoon. Garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, and east wing being repainted (noise). Umbrella left in loading bay, garden studio, and now north office. Mira and Una think north office is too cold in the evening. Hugo thinks harbour room is too cold in the morning.
Order items: 515 crates; 400 ladders.
Notes: Finn, Mira, Teo, and Suri want north office/loading bay/garden studio kept clear for visitors. Ines, Leon prefer east wing for reviews. Bram, Kira prefer loading bay. Teo, Ada prefer garden studio. Wren prefers north office. Opal asked if print room is free in morning; Opal prefers loading bay and harbour room for reviews. Bram prefers library annex for reviews. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, and loading bay are working. Morning stand-up in north office; afternoon in library annex. User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, and Kira notes from morning meeting. User needs to send Jonah notes from afternoon meeting. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Check with Kira and Hugo before morning meeting. Check with Leon before afternoon meeting.
